overview_description.description:
Tamarran is the GCC's fastest trending and home-grown gym management software and booking app that is used by sports gyms, fitness studios, sport academies, personal trainers, and recreational centers to manage and promote their businesses in a better way using a cloud-based management software that is accessible via a mobile app and a website. The platform comes in Arabic and English. More details about the gym management software can be found via: https://tamarran.com/en/business

The company is currently based in Bahrain and has recently started its expansion in KSA, UAE, and Kuwait with more than 200 venues in less than a year. Tamarran is raising funds to help in accessing GCC markets faster starting from KSA. Tamarran is striving to have the first mover advantage in the $4 billion sports and fitness market in this part of the world. The vision of this company is to become the MENA’s biggest sport community platform. A one-stop-shop for sports that connects the sport enthusiasts and service providers with each other and help them exercise, socialize and compete with each other using technology.

Tamarran is solving two important problems in this field. Firstly, it is very difficult for people to explore different sport options. It is also hard to find, compare and access the suitable sport facility, activity or personal trainer due to the scattered sources and lack of credible information. On the other side, the sport centers struggle a lot in running their businesses due to the absence of technological solutions as most of them either use manual systems, very old or very expensive solutions. Tamarran is solving these two problems by introducing one platform that connects everything together and enable people find and book a wide range of sport facilities, recreational activities and events in a fast manner while helping gym and studio owners better manage their businesses using a mobile app.
